  tagline = 'This holiday season, the best gifts come with a bow. A Christmas action-comedy with heart.',
  description = 'Hawkeye follows Clint Barton as he teams up with Kate Bishop, a young archer and his biggest fan, to confront enemies from his past as Ronin during a chaotic Christmas week in New York City.',
  imageUrl = 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310419663027009739/SGHqXeh8PZJcCDnFiAMuFi/hawkeye-featured-Bn5CtgdphNS6eXSoyZH4BG.webp',

  cardMarketContent = '## Hawkeye Cards: Kate Bishop''s Debut Premium

Hailee Steinfeld''s Kate Bishop first appearance cards are highly sought after as she''s expected to be a cornerstone of the Young Avengers. Vincent D''Onofrio''s Kingpin crossover from Netflix to Disney+ makes his cards from this era particularly valuable.',
  keyCards = '- **2023 Upper Deck Hawkeye Kate Bishop First Appearance** — Future Young Avenger leader, $10-30
- **2023 Upper Deck Hawkeye Kingpin Return** — D''Onofrio''s Disney+ debut, $10-25
- **2023 Upper Deck Hawkeye Hailee Steinfeld Auto** — Rising star autograph, $100-250+
- **2023 Upper Deck Hawkeye Yelena Belova** — Florence Pugh crossover card, $8-20',
  content = '## The Best Marvel Christmas Special

Hawkeye proved that Marvel could do small-scale, character-driven storytelling just as well as multiverse epics. Set during Christmas in New York, it had the cozy energy of a holiday action movie while dealing with real emotional weight — Clint''s guilt over his Ronin past and his desperate desire to get home to his family.

## Kate Bishop: The Next Generation

Hailee Steinfeld''s Kate Bishop was an instant star. Her enthusiasm, her competence, her ability to match Clint''s deadpan with boundless energy — she felt like the natural heir to the Avengers. Her cards immediately became hot commodities as fans recognized a future franchise leader.

## Kingpin Returns

Vincent D''Onofrio''s surprise return as Kingpin was the moment that confirmed Netflix Marvel was truly MCU canon. His appearance bridged two eras of Marvel television and set up his expanded role in Echo and Daredevil: Born Again.

## Fun Facts

- The show was filmed during Christmas in Atlanta standing in for New York
- The Rogers: The Musical scene was so popular it became a real stage show at Disneyland
- Florence Pugh''s Yelena was originally planned for a larger role before scheduling conflicts
- The trick arrows were designed by the same team that created Avengers weapons
- Lucky the Pizza Dog became a breakout character with his own merchandise line',
  metaDescription = 'Hawkeye (2021) guide — Kate Bishop debut, Kingpin return, Christmas action, trading card values, and why this show launched the next generation of Avengers.',
  keywords = 'hawkeye, kate bishop, hailee steinfeld, kingpin, disney plus marvel, clint barton, jeremy renner, yelena, marvel cards, christmas',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Upper Deck Marvel Hawkeye Kate Bishop cards',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Is Hawkeye a Christmas show?","answer":"Yes, Hawkeye is set during Christmas week in New York City and has strong holiday movie energy, making it a popular annual rewatch during the holiday season."},{"question":"Is this the same Kingpin from the Netflix shows?","answer":"Yes, Vincent D''Onofrio confirmed it is the same Wilson Fisk from the Netflix Daredevil series, now operating in the Disney+ MCU era."},{"question":"Will Kate Bishop join the Young Avengers?","answer":"Kate Bishop is expected to be a founding member of the MCU''s Young Avengers team, alongside characters like America Chavez, Cassie Lang, and Kid Loki."}]',
  status = 'published'
WHERE slug = 'hawkeye-2021'
